description: The target: a model species code, or a species_groups group_code standing for each of its members. Upper-cased and trimmed.
The evidence: an observation species code, or a group code, whose records count as the target. A species always counts as itself, so a row pairing a species with itself does nothing.
region, subregion or wsg. The most specific applicable level wins (wsg over subregion over region).
A region or subregion name from inst/extdata/wsg_regions.csv, or a watershed group code. Matched case-insensitively; a name not in the lookup errors.
yes pools the evidence into the target in this scope; no keeps them apart, and overrides a yes at a broader scope. Anything no row covers is not pooled.
low, medium or high: how firmly the evidence supports the decision.
Why the decision holds in this scope.
Where it comes from: an operator call with its date, a citation, a data set.
Date the row was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).
The link issue that made or last changed the decision.
